notes: Retries exactly one match, also under not. Reads the first present source, even when empty: aria-describedby (when an ID resolves), aria-description, a table caption, summary content or button input value that isn't the name, then a title that isn't the name; hidden referenced elements contribute and hidden elements have empty descriptions. Strings normalize whitespace; ignoreCase overrides regex flags. Failures retain observed descriptions or match counts.
